prova:
constructor
· intro h
  rcases h with ⟨O, hO, _⟩
  use 1
  refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards with x
  use 0, 1
  refine ⟨by norm_num, by positivity, by positivity, rfl⟩
· intro h
  rcases h with ⟨C, _, _⟩
  use (fun _ => C)
  refine ⟨Asymptotics.isBigO_refl _ _, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards with x
  exact le_refl _
